violations.description: All OSCE cases contain generic placeholder text instead of specific clinical imaging interpretation. Expected answers state 'The investigations show findings consistent with [condition]' without actual radiological findings.
violations.recommendation: Replace all placeholder content with specific CXR/CT/ABG/spirometry findings using systematic ABCDE/7-step approach with actual radiological abnormalities

violations.description: No systematic radiological interpretation provided. Cases lack ABCDE approach for CXR, 7-step approach for ECG, or ABC approach for CT interpretation.
violations.recommendation: Add detailed systematic interpretation: e.g., 'ABCDE: A-Trachea midline, B-Right lower zone consolidation with air bronchograms, C-CTR 50%, D-Right hemidiaphragm elevated, E-No rib fractures'

violations.description: Imaging descriptions are generic templates not specific clinical findings. E.g., 'CXR showing Acute Asthma Exacerbation' instead of 'CXR shows hyperinflated lung fields, flattened hemidiaphragms at 11th rib, increased AP diameter'
violations.recommendation: Provide actual radiological abnormalities for each modality specific to the clinical condition

violations.description: Several image types are non-standard or impossible: 'Peak Flow' as JPEG image (should be numerical value), 'Inhaler Device' as imaging, 'Action Plan Form' as medical imaging, 'Epworth' as image file
violations.location: RESP-OSCE-001 (Peak Flow), RESP-OSCE-006 (Inhaler Device), RESP-OSCE-007 (Action Plan Form), RESP-OSCE-047 (Epworth)
violations.recommendation: Replace with valid imaging modalities (CXR, CT, ultrasound, ECG) or clinical assessment tools. Peak flow should be numerical data, not JPEG.

violations.description: No assessment of image technical adequacy (CXR: rotation, inspiration, penetration; ECG: calibration, artifacts)
violations.recommendation: Add technical quality statement: 'CXR: Adequate inspiration (7 anterior ribs), no rotation (clavicular heads equidistant), adequate penetration (vertebrae visible behind heart)'

violations.description: Expected answers state 'Primary diagnosis: [X]. Differential diagnoses based on presentation' without listing actual differential diagnoses or using radiological findings to narrow differentials
violations.recommendation: Provide 3-5 specific differential diagnoses ranked by imaging findings: e.g., '1. Pneumonia (consolidation RLL), 2. PE (Hampton's hump), 3. Malignancy (mass with spiculated margins)'

violations.description: No correlation between imaging findings and clinical presentation. History states 'Clinical history relevant to [X]' without actual history, preventing radiological correlation
violations.recommendation: Add specific clinical context: e.g., '52M smoker, 3-day history productive cough, fever 38.5°C' to allow correlation with imaging findings

violations.description: While Australian sources cited (John Murtagh, AMC Handbook), specific RANZCR guidelines, Imaging Pathways, or Australian radiology reporting standards not referenced
violations.recommendation: Add RANZCR structured reporting templates, Imaging Pathways appropriateness criteria where applicable

violations.description: No mention of critical results notification protocol for urgent findings (massive PE, tension pneumothorax, aortic dissection)
violations.location: expected_answers.management for emergency cases (PE, pneumothorax, ARDS)
violations.recommendation: Add: 'Critical result: Notify referring clinician immediately (ACSQHC National Safety and Quality Health Service Standards)'

violations.description: Management answers state 'According to Australian guidelines for [X]: immediate management steps, ongoing care, and monitoring' without specific imaging-guided interventions
violations.recommendation: Imaging should guide management: e.g., 'Large pneumothorax >2cm → Chest drain (intercostal catheter), repeat CXR post-insertion to confirm lung re-expansion'

suggestions: Add actual CXR findings for pneumonia cases: 'Right lower zone airspace opacification with air bronchograms, silhouette sign obscuring right heart border (RML pneumonia), no pleural effusion'
Include systematic ECG interpretation for PE cases: 'Sinus tachycardia 110bpm, S1Q3T3 pattern (deep S in I, Q wave in III, inverted T in III), right axis deviation +110°, incomplete RBBB'

Provide CT chest descriptions using ABC approach: 'A-Trachea midline, B-Bilateral ground-glass opacification with crazy-paving pattern (alveolar edema), C-Cardiomegaly CTR 60%, small pericardial effusion'
Add ABG interpretation for respiratory failure: 'Type 2 respiratory failure: pH 7.28 (acidosis), PaCO2 68 mmHg (hypercapnia), PaO2 55 mmHg (hypoxemia), HCO3 32 (compensated), lactate 1.2'
Specify spirometry patterns: 'Obstructive pattern: FEV1/FVC 0.55 (reduced <0.7), FEV1 45% predicted, no reversibility post-bronchodilator (COPD not asthma)'
Include RANZCR structured reporting elements: Indication, Technique (kVp, mAs), Comparison, Findings (systematic), Impression (ranked differential diagnoses)
Add red flag identification: 'URGENT: Tension pneumothorax - tracheal deviation to left, mediastinal shift, flattened right hemidiaphragm → Immediate needle decompression 2nd ICS MCL before CXR'
Specify imaging appropriateness: 'CTPA indicated (Wells score 6 = PE likely, D-dimer 2500 ng/mL) per Imaging Pathways guidelines'
Provide comparison statements: 'Compared to CXR 3 days ago (date), right lower zone consolidation has progressed, now involving entire RLL'
Add radiation safety notes for CT cases: 'CT justified given clinical suspicion of PE and contraindication to V/Q scan (COPD). Effective dose ~7 mSv (ARPANSA reference level <10 mSv for chest CT)'
strengths: Comprehensive topic coverage across respiratory medicine (asthma/COPD, pneumonia, PE/DVT, ILD, respiratory failure)
Multiple imaging modalities included (CXR, CT, CTPA, ultrasound, ABG, spirometry)
Australian medical sources cited (John Murtagh, AMC Handbook, Talley & O'Connor)
RAG citations present with confidence scores >0.75
Diverse clinical scenarios (emergency, ICU, clinic, inpatient)

systematic_approach_issues: Zero OSCEs demonstrate ABCDE systematic CXR interpretation
No 7-step ECG analysis provided for PE/arrhythmia cases
ABG results not interpreted using systematic approach (pH, PaCO2, PaO2, HCO3, compensation)
content_quality_issues: All 50 OSCEs contain identical placeholder template text
No actual radiological findings described (e.g., consolidation location, size, characteristics)
Image descriptions are labels not findings: 'CXR showing pneumonia' vs 'RLL consolidation 5x3cm with air bronchograms'
Expected answers provide no educational value: 'findings consistent with X' teaches nothing about radiology interpretation
australian_context_gaps: RANZCR structured reporting templates not used
Imaging Pathways appropriateness criteria not referenced
Critical results communication (ACSQHC standards) not addressed
Australian terminology present but insufficient (need MBS item numbers for imaging appropriateness)
amc_examination_relevance: AMC Clinical Exam requires systematic interpretation - not demonstrated
Time pressure (8 minutes) requires structured approach - templates provided don't teach this
Pass standard 70% requires identifying key findings - expected answers don't specify what these are
Clinical correlation essential for AMC - vague history prevents this skill development

HIGH PRIORITY: Remove invalid image types (Peak Flow JPEG, Inhaler Device, Action Plan Form) - replace with actual imaging
MODERATE: Add technical quality assessment to all imaging cases
MODERATE: Include RANZCR structured reporting elements in expected answers
MODERATE: Add critical results notification protocols for urgent findings
BEFORE DEPLOYMENT: Pilot test with 3-5 AMC candidates to validate educational value and systematic approach teaching
